description: Hear two bars of main hits at velocity 90, followed by two bars with an added velocity-35 hit on step 12. Oilcan 1 plays the same main hits in both halves. MIDI 36 and 37 select the main timbres; MIDI 38 selects the quieter added timbre.
synchronization: Observed framebuffer/grid sampled against host monotonic recording time; not sample-exact or physical-norns calibration.
